skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the objectives of financial analysis from the perspectives of company managers, lenders, and stock analysts.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Importance and Relationship of Financial Reports
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the importance and relationship between financial reports in financial analysis.
Identify limitations of financial reports and other sources of information that analysts can use in financial analysis.
Describe the basic content of each step in the financial analysis process.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Definitions and Limitations of Financial Tools
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the definitions, uses, and limitations of tools and techniques used in financial analysis.
Calculate and explain financial ratios of a company.
Use financial ratios and other tools to evaluate the financial situation of a company in reality and forecast future financial conditions.
Identify financial issues of a company through financial analysis and propose solutions and recommendations for the company.
Understand various methods of financial analysis such as horizontal, vertical, group index analysis, and DuPont analysis.
Understand how to determine and interpret financial indicators in different groups of financial analysis indicators.
Have the ability to identify strengths and weaknesses in business operations of a company.
Have the ability to propose solutions to enhance strengths and address weaknesses in business operations.
Have the ability to detect basic forms of fraudulent financial reporting in reality.
Have the ability to develop and defend personal views on financial analysis issues in reality.
Develop good teamwork skills to complete group assignments and discussions.
Develop the ability to manage time effectively to complete all assignments with high efficiency.
Recognize and fulfill social responsibility and professional ethics when making judgments and evaluations on financial analysis issues.
Organize, evaluate, supervise, and inspire members in completing assigned tasks and social activities.
